metadata.description: Marketplace hosting the AgentForge plugin: privacy, safety and carbon checks for everyone, plus guardrails for Claude coding runs.

plugins.name: agentforge
plugins.description: Check anything before you share it with AI, and see your AI carbon footprint. Works in the Claude app with no coding: /preflight, /privacy, /safety and /footprint find passwords, bank and ID numbers, hidden instructions aimed at AI, fake links and data-leak tricks, give you a cleaned safe copy, and estimate energy and CO2. For developers, /solve, /plan, /review, /readiness and /doctor add risk scoring, policy and security checks, budget caps and carbon tracking to Claude Code runs.
